about: Who carried whose words on Storm Charles, as far as the pages themselves say: an item whose by-line names the agency (Lusa) or another outlet, and a live entry that says it relays another outlet. Edges are verbs with an inverse; counts are of items we could read. It does not see quotes or links inside an article's text. Evidence.
